## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes locally (lint + type-check + tests).
- [ ] New/changed code has tests, and coverage stays green.
- [ ] `aobench validate benchmark` passes (if I touched tasks or environments).
- [ ] Docs updated (README / `docs/` / CLI reference) where behavior changed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]`.
- [ ] I have read and agree to the [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
